suggestions.reasoning: As highlighted by the World Bank (2024), agricultural transitions and TVET reforms create new opportunities for regional workers who adapt to sustainable methods. Transitioning to clean agriculture builds directly on your strengths in enduring harsh conditions and hard work, while addressing your interest in sustainable crops.
